title: Proposed field, source and geometry can change after their seals are captured
evidence: Final common preflight does not compare mutable proposed field/heat to immutable native final seals. Narrow source probes also accept changed particle weight, spectrum, reused owner address and mutated mesh with old metadata.
closure: Use opaque immutable candidates, live owner/generation and geometry identities, and recompute final native/field/heat/source/RNG/time bindings before allocation-free publication. Mutation/fault tests must leave every accepted owner unchanged.
